title: EU DEFENSE SPENDING SURGE: EASTERN MEMBERS LEAD MILITARY BUILDUP
excerpt: Eastern EU members are dramatically increasing defense spending amid growing security concerns. Bulgaria, Slovenia, Romania, and Croatia accelerate military modernization efforts.
body: Eastern European EU members are leading a continent-wide military buildup as security concerns mount. Bulgaria accelerates fighter jet modernization and naval expansion. Slovenia commits to NATO spending targets while modernizing its armed forces. Romania fast-tracks air defense systems and coastal defense. Croatia enhances its military capabilities amid regional security challenges.
keywords: Bulgaria defense, Slovenia military, Romania security, Croatia NATO, EU defense spending
sources: European Defence Agency; NATO reports; national defense ministries
